snippet.title: Build a Factory That Fights Back | Mineral Zone Trailer
snippet.description:
Mine, automate and power an alien factory, then defend it when the night comes. Mineral Zone is factory building meets tower defense, solo or in co-op.

Wishlist Mineral Zone on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4592680/

Close the anomaly. Every night hits harder and the enemies scale forever, so your defenses have to grow with them. Lay belts, build power grids and towers, boost everything with Fluxium and call in the Orbital Strike when the line starts to break.

Between missions you level up and keep your minerals, then forge them stronger in the Resonance Forge. Research has no level cap, only your resources set the limit. Unlock and upgrade new Nexus variants and climb the global leaderboards. And somewhere beyond the rift, VAEL needs your help to save his world.

How far can you go?

Discord: https://discord.gg/baUMhNAy9X
Website: https://www.mineral-zone.com
